description: This file defines a Perl module 'Git::SVN::Prompt' providing authentication callback functions for SVN, used specifically within the 'git svn' integration. It includes methods for handling user credentials, SSL certificate validation, and prompts related to SVN authentication policies.

classes.name: Git::SVN::Prompt
classes.description: A Perl package providing callback functions for SVN authentication within git-svn, including credential prompts, SSL trust validation, and username handling.

methods.name: simple
methods.description: Handles basic username and password authentication, prompting the user if necessary, and using cached values when available.

methods.name: ssl_server_trust
methods.description: Validates the SSL server certificate, displays relevant information, and prompts the user to accept, reject, or temporarily accept the certificate.

methods.name: ssl_client_cert
methods.description: Prompts for and sets the client SSL certificate filename.

methods.name: ssl_client_cert_pw
methods.description: Prompts for and sets the password for the client SSL certificate.

methods.name: username
methods.description: Handles username retrieval by prompting the user or using cached value.

methods.name: _read_password
methods.description: Utility function to securely read a password input from the user.
